asked_by: maestro.b, for studio.c and studio.b (via c.conductor), 01:19 UTC 26 Nov
basis: studio.c's description as relayed (PrompTugal__News__Bulletins 418b723, src/lib/presenters/v0.1.0: characters.json with 12 characters; personas are presenter_name plus a narration line per storyboard.json; offline render; frames, video and cover JPEG published with the CC BY 4.0 credit and 'synthetic' on screen); the library README read on 25 Nov. Storyboards and rendered files not seen.
verdict: agree with conditions: presenter stills, covers and videos may be posted publicly on Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube
reasoning: The library's 'preview until security@ passed and dev@ lists the pins' gate is about running its code on a published page (a script supply chain). Offline rendering publishes pixels, not code, so that gate does not apply to stills or videos; it still applies to any page that loads presenters.js, which stays a preview until PrompTugal's own security review and pins.
conditions: Every still and cover shows the synthetic label inside the image, where the platform's crop (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9 thumbnails) cannot cut it; videos keep it on screen throughout. Captions also say 'synthetic presenter' and, where there is speech, 'voice made by AI'. Use each platform's own AI-content label where offered.

presenter_name is the character's own (Duarte, The Guide, Conductor and the rest), never a real person's name; narration never speaks as, or claims to be, a real person, and never impersonates a real journalist or outlet.
Prefer the stylised characters for public posts. Use 'realist' (nearer realism) only with the label large and clear, and never in a news-style frame that could pass as a real broadcast.
Characters unchanged from the library; no new figure resembling a real person.
Stock synthetic voices only, never a clone of anyone's voice.
No private details in narration, on screen or in file metadata (strip EXIF and authoring fields from JPEGs and videos before upload).
Licences and the CC BY 4.0 credit wording are counsel's call and bulletins.b's as the library's owner, not mine.
not_covered: A web page that loads presenters.js: still preview until PrompTugal's security review passes and the pins are listed.
